gaps.gap: Actual timing and causal parent-child spans
gaps.evidence_and_acceptance: Local `AgentTraceService::build` explicitly groups stages after the answer. DSH/LF: record start/end/duration and actual parent at execution; prove interleaved tool/model ordering without invented timestamps.

gaps.gap: Durable in-flight execution sequence and recovery
gaps.evidence_and_acceptance: `AgentConversationService::record` saves final turns, not checkpoints before actions. DSH: keep sequenced started/completed/failed steps in the same chat JSON; interruption test must retain last committed state.
`SupportTicketService::create` creates random IDs, then `SupportController::ask` persists chat. DSH/BG: request-key/action dedupe so retry after persistence failure cannot create a second ticket.
Existing append checks ownership, but Support runs first. Validate supplied chat ID/actor before retrieval, model calls or escalation; cross-actor test must execute zero tools.

Support model prompt uses current context/question; Enterprise restores report dates but not general transcript. DSH: bounded, owner-scoped turn selection with fresh source revalidation. History UI alone is not memory.

Trace stores source labels/counts, not complete version-bound evidence. LF: add sanitized source IDs/version hashes, prompt/tool contract version and evaluated response linkage; replay an exact synthetic fixture.
`AiClient` sets max output tokens but does not normalize returned usage. LF: optional input/output/cache usage, monotonic time/tool budgets; unknown usage remains null, never fabricated cost.

Ten local helper fixtures are useful but not end-to-end factual accuracy. LF: compare expected tool IDs/scopes/results plus model/seed/prompt version and sample cases; meaningful regressions must block, not only empty-response checks.

Audit failures are already contained; chat save failure can return retry after a successful ticket action. DSH/CW: preserve authoritative action outcome and report audit failure separately; a retry cannot repeat the action.

gaps.gap: JSON lifecycle and bounded historical queries
gaps.evidence_and_acceptance: One global lock, full JSON rewrite and file scans have no measured retention/backup lifecycle. Preserve one JSON per chat while testing pagination, bounded memory, retention, export audit and deployment restore.
Chat may store ticket ID; ticket has no normalized conversation/turn linkage. CW: link both sides, include safe handoff context and dedupe human escalation.
Ticket schema only open/answered/closed. CW: scoped assignee/team, priority, pending/snooze and queue filters; reject unauthorized assignment changes.
`created_at`/`updated_at` cannot reconstruct first human reply, handoff, resolution or reopen. CW: explicit events/timestamps; bot latency must not be sold as human response time.

Local feedback is binary and sampled, not production CSAT. CW: preserve explicit resolution, separate satisfaction and sample denominators; no silence-as-success, stale votes or another actor's ratings.

#249 fixes the named Ayyappa case, not general multilingual retrieval. DSH/LF/CW: normalized intent/entities, real no-match, source citations, negative-feedback-to-fixture workflow and human-approved knowledge correction.
`CartService` reads the PHP session; no business cart identity/state. BG: persistent cart with guest-to-account merge and price/stock revalidation; never merge another user's basket.
Local telemetry counts cart add/checkout start only. BG/DSH: allowlisted cart/checkout/payment/verified-order events with safe correlation and idempotency; client claims cannot certify payment.
No persistent cart denominator/window. BG: derive age and conversion from cart state, disclose cohort and exclude retries; do not divide uncorrelated event counts. Recovery messaging needs consent.
Product schema has one price/stock status, not configurable SKUs. BG: add only for a real size/material requirement; selection must survive cart/order/GST line validation.
Current availability/on-hold safeguard does not track quantities or allocations. BG: atomic reserved/available quantity, oversell tests and explicit release rules; retain paid-order safeguards.
Order-level shipped status cannot express multiple dispatches. BG: line ordered/shipped/cancelled/refunded bounds; concurrent shipments cannot exceed remaining quantity.

Verified monetary refunds already exist. BG: request/decision/line quantities, allocation and tax/invoice linkage without pretending a gateway refund happened. Test partial/multiple refund reconciliation.
Existing coupon dates, spend, caps, usage and free shipping are present. BG: optional product/category/customer eligibility and explicit stacking/rounding; do not replace working coupons.
No scoped repository/routes in inspected schema/code. BG: optional owner-bound saved items with move-to-cart revalidation; never build without customer demand.
